sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Provincial Assembly Powers Immunities and Privileges Second Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1990
ACT III OF 1990
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY (POWERS, IMMUNITIES AND PRIVILEGES) (2ND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act to further
amend the North-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities
and Privileges) Act, 1988
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 25th February, 1990]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/90/3204,
dated 25-2-1990.--TheNorth-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (2nd Amendment) Bill, 1990,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 21st February, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 24th February, 1990 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the North -West Frontier Province
Provincial Assembly (Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (2nd Amendment) Act,
1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 25th February, 1990]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis/90/3204,
dated 25-2-1990.--TheNorth-West Frontier Province Provincial Assembly
(Powers, Immunities and Privileges) (2nd Amendment) Bill, 1990,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 21st February, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 24th February, 1990 is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
3. Addition of section 26-A in the N.-W.F.P. Act
No. IX of 1988. After
section 26 of the principal Act, a new section 26-A may be added, namely:--
"26-A. COGNIZANCE OF
OFFENCE:
(1) Subject to the provisions of
this Act, if the Privileges Committee of the House, constituted under the Rules
of Business in vogue, is satisfied that an accused has breached the privilege
of the House or a Committee thereof or of a Member within the meaning of
section 24 of this Act, and punishment is to be inflicted upon him under
section 25 of this Act a reference shall be made to the Judicial Committee, and
(2) On receipt of the reference,
the Judicial Committee shall initiate proceedings against the accused in
accordance with this Act and rules framed thereunder."
